scope: Three matched raw Cycles camera views and their three HDR color-only OIDN versions, inspected as actual pixels at 640x640.
reference_agreement: Not evaluated; no photographic reference supplied or inspected.
comparison_type: Look-development revisions: samples, materials, lighting, stage, and source geometry changed. Not a one-variable performance or image-quality benchmark.

resolved_or_improved.detail: Cup/liquid/stream have zero non-manifold edges and positive signed volume in saved final scene; nozzle bore 0.0978 exceeds stream top radius 0.0918. Source markers fit within card bounds. These checks do not prove all self-intersections or fluid physics.
OIDN removes most visible grain in each view and preserves the primary rim, stream and metal silhouettes; fine liquid detail softens. Raw noise remains.
Final hero right lower fill has less broad pale wash. Side has legible refraction but bright reflection patches remain; darker top/front faces lose some clear-medium readability.
Final per-camera manifests retain camera-specific settings and timing. Gate binds all three image hashes.

remaining_findings.finding: Substantial middle portion of upper stream disappears against the dark background in both raw and denoised hero.
remaining_findings.acceptance_check: A visible continuous edge or reflection connects nozzle to impact at hero, side and top without changing the intended clear medium.

remaining_findings.finding: Dark setup trades pale-wash reduction for suppressed wall/free-surface detail and dominant isolated reflection patches.
remaining_findings.acceptance_check: The clear liquid reads as a filled volume in every view with deliberate transmitted/refracted detail and no washed-out or blacked-out interfaces.

remaining_findings.finding: 36-frame motion demonstration uses the earlier iteration-002 look and has only frame-sheet visual inspection, not live playback review.
remaining_findings.acceptance_check: Before final-film acceptance, render final geometry/look and inspect actual playback for stream continuity and temporal noise.

positive_observations: Finite vessel wall, rim, and base thickness remain readable in appropriate views.
Top view provides a distinct liquid free surface and receiving stream.
Metal witness has shaped, metallic reflections and grounded support.
No excessive bloom or overall white highlight wash.
decision_owner: Project director; independent reviewer recommends no beauty acceptance and no fourth attempt in this run.
